title: Substack article, validation loss versus accuracy
prompt_text: Write a Substack article of 550 to 650 words for readers who have trained a model or two but have no maths background. Title it yourself. The topic: why validation accuracy can keep improving while validation loss gets worse during training, what that pattern tells you about the model, and what to do about it. Include one small worked example with made-up numbers (a handful of examples with their predicted probabilities before and after a few more epochs) that shows the effect. Finish with one practical takeaway. No code, no bullet points, no headings inside the body.
